metaTitle: Motion App Alternative in {{CURRENT_YEAR}}: AI Assistant, Free Tier
metaDescription: Motion is a paid smart calendar with no email integration. GAIA creates tasks from Gmail and flags calendar conflicts, with a free tier. Compare pricing.
whyPeopleLook: Motion's AI auto-scheduling is genuinely impressive — it slots your tasks into available calendar blocks and reschedules them when meetings pop up. But as a paid plan, it is expensive for a single-purpose tool, and it has a fundamental blind spot: it cannot read your email. Tasks still need to be manually entered, which means the cognitive load of inbox triage remains entirely on you. GAIA addresses the full picture by connecting email, calendar, and tasks into one proactive system where tasks are created from emails automatically and scheduled with calendar awareness.

faqs.question: Does GAIA auto-schedule tasks into my calendar like Motion?
faqs.answer: GAIA provides calendar-aware task prioritization and scheduling suggestions rather than fully automatic task-to-calendar slotting. It excels at proactive awareness rather than hard schedule enforcement.

faqs.question: Is GAIA cheaper than Motion?
faqs.answer: Motion is a paid plan. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month with much broader functionality including email management, Deep integrations, and workflow automation. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs).

faqs.question: Can GAIA create tasks from email like Motion cannot?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is one of GAIA's core strengths. It reads your Gmail and can automatically create, prioritize, and schedule tasks from email content — something Motion requires you to do manually.

faqs.question: Does GAIA handle meeting scheduling like Motion?
faqs.answer: GAIA can manage Google Calendar events, detect scheduling conflicts, and help draft scheduling emails. For the specific auto-scheduling-into-calendar-blocks feature, Motion is currently more specialized.
